simple.question: If the vendor breaks the deal badly, how long do they get to put it right?
simple.gold_span: fails to cure that breach within thirty (30) days
simple.answer: The length of the remedy period varies depending on the specific agreement in question. Under the Master Services Agreement, the other party has thirty (30) days to cure a material breach after receiving notice (source [1]). The Northwind Logistics Agreement allows for 60 days (source [4]), while the Initech Payments Agreement extends this period to 90 days (source [5]). Therefore, the time allowed for the vendor to address a material breach ranges from 30 to 90 days depending on the agreement.
